summary: PowerBank Corp filed a Form 6-K attaching a press release confirming equipment procurement agreements totaling $242.3 million USD in construction value for 23 distributed solar and energy storage projects in New York and Pennsylvania. The projects represent 97 MW DC of solar and 42 MWh of storage, expected to power 11,000 homes. Estimated Investment Tax Credits under the One Big Beautiful Bill Act are $94.7 million USD. No specific price per share, premium, board recommendation, advisor, or deal mechanics typical of special situations are provided. This is a routine business update on project funding and tax credit eligibility, not a special situation event.
